name: Popover
purpose: Rich anchored content that opens on CLICK — Tooltip's interactive sibling. Where a Tooltip annotates a label with plain text on hover/focus, a Popover holds structured, focusable content (title, body, link, dismiss) as a non-modal dialog anchored to its trigger. If the user can act inside it, it is a Popover; if it is a sentence of help text, it is a Tooltip; if it must interrupt, it is a Modal.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class — title .t-ed-body .em; body .t-ed-body-small
tokens.surface: background/default + elevation/border (dark outline) + elevation/functional shadow — the Tooltip/Dropdown anchored-overlay recipe
tokens.states: close × colour-only pending button-family partial injection (ADR-0013): hover tertiary/background/hover, active adds the token darken

motion.entry: Opacity fade 150ms; placement is instant (no slide).
motion.reducedMotion: Fade collapses to .01ms; active darken removed.

responsive.rule: max-width 320px; clamps to the viewport with 10px padding; tail keeps pointing at the trigger at any clamp.

mustNotNeighbour: A second open popover (one at a time)

accessibility.role: Non-modal dialog: role="dialog" + aria-labelledby, NO aria-modal. Trigger: aria-haspopup="dialog" + aria-expanded + aria-controls.
accessibility.name: Title labels the dialog; close carries aria-label="Close popover".
accessibility.keyboard: Focus moves to the first focusable on open; Tab is NOT trapped — focus leaving closes it; Esc closes and returns focus to the trigger.
accessibility.focus: Visible :focus-visible (focus/ring) on trigger, link and close.
accessibility.nonText: Dark-mode outline = elevation/border ≥3:1 vs page (the anchored-overlay recipe).

antiPatterns: Opening on hover (that is Tooltip; popovers are click-committed)
aria-modal / focus trap on a popover (non-modal by definition — use Modals to interrupt)
Popover content that scrolls (too much content — use a Drawer or Modal)
A popover as the only path to essential content (it is dismissible and anchored)
Re-implementing press physics locally on the close control (ADR-0013 ratchet)
